metadata.description: Feature transformation configuration for Random Forest and K-Means ML models

direct.description: Use raw values directly (RF handles numerical features well)

one_hot.description: Convert categorical variables to binary columns

extract_fields.description: Extract specific fields from complex objects

content_analysis.description: Text/semantic features analyzed in separate ContentAnalysis system
content_analysis.reason: Rich semantic content - analyzed separately to preserve nuanced insights (see ContentAnalysis.md)

exclude.description: Features not used in RF model

scale_0_1.description: Min-max normalization to [0-1] range (already normalized features)

log_scale.description: Log transform followed by min-max scaling (for skewed distributions)
log_scale.rationale: Handles right-skewed distributions (counts, metrics with viral outliers)

one_hot.description: Convert categorical to binary columns (distance-based clustering friendly)

cyclical.description: Encode cyclical temporal features using sin/cos transformation
cyclical.formula: sin(2π * value / period), cos(2π * value / period)

shift_scale.description: Shift range then scale (for features with negative values)

label_encode_simple.description: Simple label encoding for low-cardinality categorical features

extract_fields_scale.description: Extract fields from objects, then scale

content_analysis.description: Text/semantic features analyzed in separate ContentAnalysis system
content_analysis.reason: Rich semantic content - analyzed separately to preserve nuanced insights (see ContentAnalysis.md)

exclude.description: Features not used in K-Means clustering

transform_definitions.Direct: Use raw values without transformation (RF handles well)
transform_definitions.One-hot: Binary encoding: create N binary columns for N categories
transform_definitions.Extract-date: Parse timestamp into hour, day_of_week, month, is_weekend, etc.
transform_definitions.Extract-fields: Extract nested fields from object/dict structures
transform_definitions.Text-embed: Convert text to numerical vectors (TF-IDF or embeddings)
transform_definitions.Log + scale: Log transform to reduce skewness, then min-max scale
transform_definitions.Cyclical: Sin/cos encoding for cyclical features (hour, day, month)
transform_definitions.Shift + scale: Shift negative ranges to positive, then scale
transform_definitions.Exclude: Do not use this feature in model

preprocessing_steps: 1. Extract fields from complex objects (gender_detection, hashtag_analysis)

kmeans.input: All numerical features with similar scales
kmeans.output: Normalized feature matrix ready for KMeans clustering
kmeans.critical: All features MUST be scaled to similar ranges (K-Means is distance-based)

feature_count_summary.note: Only 1 feature requires complex transformation: create_time (temporal extraction)
